Bid Security/Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) i) The Bid Security (EMD) for an amount mentioned in Tender Notice will have to be deposited & sub mitted with Technical Bid in the form of a Account Payee Demand Draft / deposit at call receipt or an FDR/TDR or Banker’s Cheque or Bank Guarantee in original duly pledged in favour of Postgraduate Institut e of Medical Education and Research, Chandigarh and having its validity for at least One Year and issued b y a Scheduled Commercial Bank. This bid security (EMD) may be attached with the Technical Bid. FDR/TD R issued for less amount and/or issued by Banks before the date of floating this NIT shall not be accepted & bids received with such FDR/TDR shall summarily be rejected. Micro Small & Medium Enterprises as also startups as recognized by the department of MSME are exempted for submission of EMD on production of r equisite certificate. To safeguard against a bidder’s withdrawing or altering its bid during the bid validity period in the ca se of advertised, Limited and Single Tender Enquiry, the bidders, except Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs ) and startups as defined in MSE Procurement Policy issued by Department of Micro, Small and Medium E nterprises (MSME) or are registered with the Central Purchase Organization or the concerned Ministry or De partment, shall submit Bid Security (EMD) with the technical bid which should be for an amount as requisiti oned in this NIT. ii. Bid Security shall be accepted in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft, Fixed Deposit Receipt, Banker’s Cheque or Bank Guarantee, from any of the Scheduled Commercial Bank duly pledged in favour of Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research, Chandigarh & to remain valid for a period of ONE year taken from the date of floating tender by the Institute. Banks Guarantee issued from the foreign banks must be authenticated by STATE BANK OF INDIA or any other Nationalized Bank of India. iii. Bid Security, if noticed tempered with and not found in order, shall not be accepted and such bids shall be liable to be rejected. iv Conditions for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) 1. As per Public Procurement Policy (PPP) for Micro & Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 issue d vide Gazette Notification dated 23.03.2012 by Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises of Govt of India, MSEs must be registered with any of the following in order to avail the benefits/preference available vide public Procurement Policy MSEs Order, 2012. a. District Industries Centers (DIC) b. Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) c. Khadi and Village Industries Board d. Coir Board e. National Small Industries Corporation (NSIC) f. Directorate of Handicraft and Handloom g. Any other body specified by Ministry of MSME (MoMSME) h. Udyog Aadhar Acknowledgement/Udyog Aadhar Memorandum issued by MOMSME. 2. MSEs participating in the tender must submit valid & authorized copy of certificate of registration w ith any one of the above agencies. In case of bidders submitting DIC registration certificate shall attach ori ginal notarized copy of the DIC certificate. The MSE’s Bidder to note and ensure that nature of services and goods/items manufactured mentioned in MSE’s as per MSE guidelines issued by MoMSME. 3. Under MSE category, only manufacturer for goods and service providers for services are eligible for exemption from EMD. 4. Traders/Resellers/Distributors/Authorized agents will not be considered for availing benefits under PP Policy 2012 for MSEs as per MSE guidelines issued by MoMSME. 5. The registration certificate issued from any one of the above agencies must be valid as on Bid Closi ng date of the tender. Bidder shall ensure validity of registration certificate in case bid closing date is exte nded. 6. The MSEs who have applied for registration or renewal of registration with any of the above agencie s/bodies, but have not obtained the valid certificate as on close date of the tender are not eligible for exem ption/preference.

7. The MSEs registered with above mentioned agencies/bodies are exempted from payment of Earnes t Money Deposit (EMD). Micro and Small Enterprises are not exempted from performance security. Micro a nd Small Enterprises shall have to furnish performance security, if purchase order is placed with them. Th ere is no relaxation in this regard. The firm has to give an affidavit on a non-judicial stamp paper that there is no criminal /vigilance/CBI case pending against the fir m/supplier. The Principals and/or bidders shall submit a rate certificate in the Performa given below: “The bidder undertakes that they have not supplied/not supplying during past one year similar goods at a price lower than that offer ed in the present bid to any other Procurement entity of the Gove rnment of India and if it is found at any stage that the similar Goo ds were sup plied by the bidder to any other Procurement Entity o f the Government of India at a lower price, then that very price, wi th due charges for elapsed time, will be applicable to the present case and the difference in the cost would be refunded by the bidd er to the buyer, if the contract has already been concluded”. The sellers are requested to submit sample (10 p Note: airs of each size) of the quoted product in a sealed envelope and st amped by the firm and it will be super-scribed on the preface of the envelope “SAMPLE AGAINST BID NUM BER, PRODUCT NAME, DUE DATE, NAME OF THE PARTICIPATED FIRM ( complete address, contact number, mail ID)” Bid without sample will not be considered. The sample will be received manually / speed post / registered post / courier on or before due da te and time mentioned against bid number at Sample Store, Central Store, Nehru Hospital, PGIMER, Chand igarh. The sample envelope should be addressed to the In-charge Sample Store/ Store Officer, Central Stor e, 2nd Floor, C-Block, Nehru Hospital, PGIMER, Sector 12, Chandigarh – 160012. Sample will no t be accepted / receive after due date and time for submissi on of bid and the same shall be summarily ignored. .
